D017.additional_condition: Presence of preoccupation with weight/body shape
D017.key_difference: Scope of concern regarding appearance defects

D017: Preoccupation with appearance defects includes various body parts (skin, features, muscles, etc.) beyond weight and body shape.
D021: Preoccupation with appearance defects is limited to weight and body shape, and restriction of food intake is accompanied.

D017.additional_condition: Presence of repetitive thoughts and behaviors regarding appearance
D017.key_difference: Scope of repetitive thoughts and behaviors

D017: Repetitive thoughts and behaviors are focused exclusively on appearance due to preoccupation with appearance.
D016: Repetitive thoughts and behaviors appear across various areas besides appearance.

D017: Prominent preoccupation with appearance and excessive repetitive behaviors are present, and depressive symptoms are experienced due to the resulting distress.
D013: Depressive symptoms including low self-esteem regarding appearance are accompanied, but preoccupation with specific body parts and compulsive behaviors are not accompanied.

D017: Anxiety and worry are limited to perceived appearance defects, and prominent preoccupation with appearance and repetitive behaviors are accompanied.
D011: Anxiety and worry include future problems in various areas including appearance.

D017.additional_condition: Presence of delusional beliefs regarding body/appearance defects
D017.key_difference: Presence of delusional beliefs regarding body/appearance defects and compulsive behaviors

D017: Holds delusional beliefs about body appearance/defects, and repetitive and ritualistic compulsive behaviors are accompanied.
D004: Delusions related to body appearance/defects may appear, but repetitive and ritualistic compulsive behaviors are not accompanied.

D017.additional_condition: Presence of delusional beliefs regarding body/appearance defects

D017: Holds delusional beliefs about body appearance/defects, but other psychotic symptoms of schizophrenia are not accompanied.
D005: Holds delusional beliefs about body appearance/defects, and other psychotic symptoms are accompanied.
